capabilities: Compare local notes and attachments with a WebDAV folder by content
Merge independent line edits with a three-way merge
Retain previous versions and check write preconditions
extras: Desktop only; no mobile support. Existing-file WebDAV writes require a strong ETag and conditional-request support. Passwords stay in memory by default, with optional SecretStorage. Excludes .obsidian and other configured folders.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compare a vault with a WebDAV folder by content and resolve conflicts before syncing.

relations.evidence: the project's MDSync development origins are documented in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

summary: WebDAV content comparison and conflict-resolution plugin that checks notes and attachments, merges independent line edits, and writes only after confirmation.
